title: Wanted Criminal Escapes From Police In The Worst Way Possible
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 2, 2022, an officer attempted to conduct a traffic stop on a male driver wanted for felonious assault in Warren, OH. He refused to pull over and lead police on a short pursuit. He eventually crashed into another vehicle and fled on foot. As police continued to pursue him, the suspect forcefully entered a daycare building as an employee made their way inside. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
